artworks.title: Shipwreck of the Greek Fleet on the Voyage Home from Troy
artworks.description: Nationalmuseum Stockholm: returning hulls smashed on a storm coast — the Caphareus disaster tradition in which Nauplius' false beacons wreck the victors for Palamedes.

popCulture.title: Nauplius
popCulture.description: The Argonaut father who wrecked the returning fleet after Palamedes' murder — vengeance as false beacons on the Euboean shore.

popCulture.title: Palamedes
popCulture.description: Nauplius' son, framed at Troy — the injustice that turns a father's grief into a coast of wrecked homecomings.
